title: rolter · gateway capacity
description: Provider queues and Redis-backed admission controls on the gateway, from its OTLP metrics (#1862, #1772). Imported by `just dogfood`. Panels query signoz_metrics directly, like the other boards, and compute the wait p95 from the histogram buckets in plain SQL, so they need no custom function.

widgets.title: Provider queue wait p95
widgets.description: How long requests waited for a provider queue worker, from the rolter_provider_queue_wait_ms histogram. A rising line means the provider's [provider_queue] workers are the bottleneck, not the provider.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT ts, provider, value FROM ( SELECT ts, provider, arraySort(b -> b.1, groupArray((toFloat64(le), waits))) AS buckets, arrayMap(b -> b.1, buckets) AS bounds, arrayMap(b -> b.2, buckets) AS counts, counts[-1] AS total, 0.95 * total AS rank, arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= rank, counts) AS i, if(i > 1, bounds[i - 1], 0) AS lower, if(i > 1, counts[i - 1], 0) AS below, if(isInfinite(bounds[i]), lower, lower + (bounds[i] - lower) * (rank - below) / greatest(counts[i] - below, 1)) AS value FROM ( SELECT ts, provider, le, sum(increase) AS waits FROM ( SELECT ts, provider, le, per_minute - lagInFrame(per_minute, 1, per_minute) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY ts ASC ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta, if(delta < 0, per_minute, delta) AS increase FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, s.fingerprint AS fingerprint, any(t.provider) AS provider, any(t.le) AS le, max(s.value) AS per_minute FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider, JSONExtractString(labels, 'le') AS le FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'rolter_provider_queue_wait_ms.bucket' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}} - 60000, 3600000) * 3600000 ) AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name = 'rolter_provider_queue_wait_ms.bucket' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} - 60000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts, fingerprint ) ) GROUP BY ts, provider, le ) GROUP BY ts, provider HAVING total > 0 ) ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Provider queue depth
widgets.description: Requests waiting for a worker, per provider. A gauge sampled at the OTLP export interval, so a burst shorter than it can fall between samples; the wait p95 records every wait.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, t.provider AS provider, max(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'rolter_provider_queue_depth' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}}, 3600000) * 3600000) AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name = 'rolter_provider_queue_depth' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts, provider ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Provider in-flight
widgets.description: Upstream calls awaiting response headers, per provider. Flat at the worker count means the queue is saturated.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, t.provider AS provider, max(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS provider FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'rolter_provider_inflight' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}}, 3600000) * 3600000) AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name = 'rolter_provider_inflight' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts, provider ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Redis connected
widgets.description: 1 while each Redis consumer holds a live connection. It reflects the last use, so an idle consumer does not probe.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, t.consumer AS consumer, min(s.value) AS value FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, JSONExtractString(labels, 'consumer') AS consumer FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'rolter_redis_connected' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}}, 3600000) * 3600000) AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name = 'rolter_redis_connected' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts, consumer ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Requests admitted unchecked
widgets.description: Requests a budget or rate limit let through per minute because Redis was unavailable: the cost exposure of an outage.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT ts, control, sum(if(delta < 0, per_minute, delta)) AS value FROM ( SELECT ts, control, per_minute, per_minute - lagInFrame(per_minute, 1, per_minute) OVER (PARTITION BY fingerprint ORDER BY ts ASC ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, s.fingerprint AS fingerprint, any(t.control) AS control, max(s.value) AS per_minute FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fingerprint, JSONExtractString(labels, 'control') AS control FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name = 'rolter_fail_open_total' AND unix_milli >= intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}} - 60000, 3600000) * 3600000) AS t ON s.fingerprint = t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name = 'rolter_fail_open_total' AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}} - 60000 AND s.unix_milli <= {{.end_timestamp_ms}} GROUP BY ts, fingerprint)) WHERE ts >= toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv({{.start_timestamp_ms}}, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) GROUP BY ts, control ORDER BY ts
